pinyin: rén wú yuǎn lǜ, bì yǒu jìn yōu
literal: person · lack · distant · concern, surely · have · near · worry
natural: no foresight, no peace

meaning.en: A person without long-term foresight will soon face trouble.
meaning.zh: 一个人如果没有长远的考虑，眼前就一定会有忧患。

equivalents: he who does not plan ahead will soon have problems

examples.zh: 人无远虑，必有近忧，投资前要想清楚风险。
examples.en: Without long-term thinking, trouble is close at hand; think through the risks before investing.

examples.zh: 他从不存钱，真是人无远虑必有近忧。
examples.en: He never saves; without foresight, worries soon arrive.

examples.zh: 人无远虑，必有近忧，创业要有长远规划。
examples.en: Without foresight there are near-term worries; a start-up needs a long-term plan.

story.en: Confucius: 'If a person has no distant concerns, he will surely have worries near at hand' (人无远虑，必有近忧).
story.zh: 《论语·卫灵公》：“子曰：人无远虑，必有近忧。”

usage.en: Advice to plan ahead; formal.
usage.zh: 劝人长远打算，书面语。

text: 有心栽花花不开，无心插柳柳成荫
pinyin: yǒu xīn zāi huā huā bù kāi, wú xīn chā liǔ liǔ chéng yīn
variants: 有心栽花花不开无心插柳柳成荫
literal: have · intent · plant · flowers · flowers · not · bloom, no · intent · stick · willow · willow · form · shade
natural: the harder you try, the less you get; the unplanned succeeds

meaning.en: Flowers planted with care fail to bloom, while willow twigs stuck in casually grow into shade: success often comes unplanned.
meaning.zh: 用心栽花，花却没开；随手插柳，柳树却长成了绿荫。比喻刻意追求的得不到，无意中却得到了成功。

equivalents: success comes when you least expect it

examples.zh: 有心栽花花不开，无心插柳柳成荫，他随便写的书竟成了畅销书。
examples.en: Flowers planted with care don't bloom while a willow twig stuck in carelessly grows shade: the book he wrote casually became a bestseller.

examples.zh: 无心插柳柳成荫，这次合作是意外的收获。
examples.en: The willow stuck in without thought forms a shade; this collaboration was an unexpected gain.

examples.zh: 他无心插柳，却认识了未来的妻子。
examples.en: He wasn't looking for anything, yet met his future wife.

usage.en: About unexpected results; the second half is often used alone for happy accidents.
usage.zh: 常指意外结果；后半句常单独用于无意中取得成功。

pinyin: háo bù lì jǐ, zhuān mén lì rén
literal: not at all · benefit · self, solely · benefit · others
natural: utterly selfless

meaning.en: Without the slightest thought for oneself, devoted entirely to benefiting others.
meaning.zh: 一点儿也不为自己打算，专门为别人着想。

examples.zh: 他毫不利己，专门利人，大家都敬佩他。
examples.en: He is utterly selfless and everyone admires him.

examples.zh: 白求恩大夫是毫不利己，专门利人的典范。
examples.en: Dr Bethune was a model of selflessness.

examples.zh: 志愿者们毫不利己，专门利人。
examples.en: The volunteers are completely selfless, working only for others.

story.en: Mao Zedong's essay in memory of Dr Norman Bethune praises him for 'being utterly without self-interest, devoted entirely to others' (毫不利己，专门利人), as a model of internationalist spirit.
story.zh: 毛泽东《纪念白求恩》（1939年）：“一个人能力有大小，但只要有这点精神，就是一个高尚的人，一个纯粹的人，一个有道德的人，一个脱离了低级趣味的人，一个有益于人民的人。”文中赞扬白求恩“毫不利己，专门利人”。

usage.en: Praise of selflessness; formal, associated with Mao's essay on Dr Norman Bethune.
usage.zh: 称赞无私，书面语，出自毛泽东悼念白求恩的文章。

pinyin: rén zhě yào shān, zhì zhě yào shuǐ
literal: benevolent · one · delights in · mountains, wise · one · delights in · water
natural: the kind love mountains, the wise love water

meaning.en: The benevolent find joy in mountains, the wise in water.
meaning.zh: 仁德的人喜爱山，智慧的人喜爱水。用来形容人的性格和志趣与山水相应。

equivalents: the kind-hearted love mountains and the wise love water

examples.zh: 仁者乐山，智者乐水，他喜欢爬山，她喜欢游泳。
examples.en: The benevolent love mountains and the wise love water: he likes climbing and she likes swimming.

examples.zh: 仁者乐山，所以他定居在山区。
examples.en: The benevolent delight in mountains, so he settled in the hills.

examples.zh: 仁者乐山、智者乐水的说法流传了两千多年。
examples.en: The saying that the benevolent love mountains and the wise love water has circulated for over two thousand years.

story.en: Confucius: 'The wise delight in water, the benevolent delight in mountains; the wise are active, the benevolent are still; the wise are joyful, the benevolent live long' (知者乐水，仁者乐山).
story.zh: 《论语·雍也》：“子曰：知者乐水，仁者乐山。知者动，仁者静。知者乐，仁者寿。”

usage.en: Remember 乐 reads yào here, not lè; often used jokingly about temperament and travel.
usage.zh: 注意“乐”读yào；常用来谈性格和旅游喜好。

pinyin: sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
literal: three · people · walk, surely · have · my · teacher
natural: there is always someone to learn from

meaning.en: Among any three people walking together, there is surely one I can learn from.
meaning.zh: 几个人同行，其中一定有可以做我老师的人。比喻要虚心向他人学习。

equivalents: everyone has something to teach you

examples.zh: 三人行，必有我师，要多向别人请教。
examples.en: Among three travellers there's always a teacher for me; ask others for advice.

examples.zh: 三人行必有我师，他从实习生身上也学到了东西。
examples.en: Among three there's always one to learn from; he learned even from the interns.

examples.zh: 三人行，必有我师焉，别觉得自己了不起。
examples.en: Among three people there's a teacher for me, so don't think you're so great.

story.en: Confucius: 'Where three people walk, there is surely a teacher for me: I pick out their good points and follow them, and their bad points I correct in myself' (三人行，必有我师焉).
story.zh: 《论语·述而》：“子曰：三人行，必有我师焉。择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。”

usage.en: Advice to be humble and learn from others.
usage.zh: 劝人虚心向别人学习。

text: 横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛
pinyin: héng méi lěng duì qiān fū zhǐ, fǔ shǒu gān wéi rú zǐ niú
literal: glare · brows · coldly · face · thousand · men · 's · pointing, bow · head · willing · be · child · 's · ox
natural: defiant to enemies, devoted to the people

meaning.en: Glaring coolly at the accusing crowd, yet willing to bow like an ox serving children: stern toward enemies, devoted to the people.
meaning.zh: 冷眼面对众人的指责，却甘愿像老黄牛一样为人民服务。

equivalents: stern to foes, devoted to the people

examples.zh: 横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛，是鲁迅精神的写照。
examples.en: Glaring coolly at a thousand accusers and bowing like an ox for children captures Lu Xun's spirit.

examples.zh: 老师俯首甘为孺子牛，为教育事业奉献了一生。
examples.en: The teacher devoted a lifetime to education, serving like a willing ox.

examples.zh: 面对不公，他横眉冷对，对群众却俯首甘为孺子牛。
examples.en: He faced injustice sternly, yet served the people like an ox.

story.en: Lu Xun's poem 'Self-mockery' (1932) has the couplet 'Glaring coldly at a thousand accusing fingers, I bow my head and gladly serve as the children's ox' (横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛).
story.zh: 鲁迅《自嘲》（1932年）：“运交华盖欲何求，未敢翻身已碰头。……横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛。”

usage.en: Often quoted of public servants and teachers; the second half is used alone.
usage.zh: 常用来赞美为人民服务的人或教师；后半句也可单独使用。

pinyin: rén ér wú xìn, bù zhī qí kě yě
literal: person · yet · lack · trust, not · know · it · acceptable
natural: a person without trust is not acceptable

meaning.en: A person without good faith is hardly acceptable; I don't see what he can be good for.
meaning.zh: 一个人不讲信用，不知道他还怎么立身处世。

equivalents: a person without trustworthiness is of no use
trust is the foundation of a person

examples.zh: 人而无信，不知其可也，做生意先要讲信用。
examples.en: A person without trust is not acceptable; in business, credibility comes first.

examples.zh: 人而无信，朋友也会离他而去。
examples.en: People without trust lose their friends.

examples.zh: 孔子说人而无信不知其可，诚信是立身之本。
examples.en: Confucius said a person without trust cannot be accepted; honesty is the root of conduct.

story.en: Confucius: 'A person without trust: I do not know what he can do. A large cart without a yoke-pin, a small cart without a crossbar-pin—how could they go?' (人而无信，不知其可也).
story.zh: 《论语·为政》：“子曰：人而无信，不知其可也。大车无輗，小车无軏，其何以行之哉？”

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of honesty and credit.
usage.zh: 谈论诚信时引用。

text: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧
pinyin: liú dé qīng shān zài, bù pà méi chái shāo
literal: keep · obtain · green · hills · remain, not · fear · lack · firewood · burn
natural: as long as there's life, there's hope

meaning.en: As long as the green hills remain, there is no fear of running out of firewood: keep your base and you can recover.
meaning.zh: 只要青山还在，就不愁没有柴烧。比喻只要保住根本，就有希望东山再起。

examples.zh: 生意失败了不要紧，留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。
examples.en: It doesn't matter that the business failed; so long as the hills are green, there'll be firewood.

examples.zh: 留得青山在，我们先保存实力。
examples.en: While the green hills remain, let's first conserve our strength.

examples.zh: 别灰心，留得青山在，还有机会。
examples.en: Don't lose heart: as long as you keep the hills, there's a chance.

usage.en: Comforting advice after a setback.
usage.zh: 挫折后的安慰话。

text: 好事不出门，坏事传千里
pinyin: hǎo shì bù chū mén, huài shì chuán qiān lǐ
literal: good · news · not · leave · door, bad · news · travel · thousand · li
natural: good news stays home, bad news spreads

meaning.en: Good deeds stay behind closed doors, while bad ones spread for a thousand li.
meaning.zh: 好事传不远，坏事却传得很快。

examples.zh: 好事不出门，坏事传千里，他的一点小过错很快人人皆知。
examples.en: Good news stays home and bad news travels a thousand miles; his small mistake was soon known to all.

examples.zh: 好事不出门，坏事传千里，网络时代更是如此。
examples.en: Good news doesn't leave home but bad news flies; so much more in the Internet age.

examples.zh: 好事不出门，他做了很多善事，却没人知道。
examples.en: Good deeds don't get out of the door: he did much good but no one knows.

usage.en: Observation on how rumours and scandals spread.
usage.zh: 感叹坏消息传得快。

pinyin: rén bù fàn wǒ, wǒ bù fàn rén
literal: people · not · offend · me, I · not · offend · people
natural: I won't attack unless attacked

meaning.en: If others do not attack me, I will not attack them (but if they do, I will strike back).
meaning.zh: 别人不侵犯我，我也不侵犯别人。后面常接“人若犯我，我必犯人”。

equivalents: live and let live (but strike back if attacked)

examples.zh: 人不犯我，我不犯人，但谁想欺负我们也不行。
examples.en: I won't offend unless offended, but no one may bully us.

examples.zh: 人不犯我，我不犯人；人若犯我，我必犯人。
examples.en: If you don't attack me I won't attack you; if you do I will surely hit back.

examples.zh: 他向来人不犯我，我不犯人。
examples.en: He has always held that he won't bother anyone who leaves him alone.

usage.en: Statement of defensive stance; often followed by 人若犯我，我必犯人.
usage.zh: 表示自卫立场，常接“人若犯我，我必犯人”。

text: 病来如山倒，病去如抽丝
pinyin: bìng lái rú shān dǎo, bìng qù rú chōu sī
literal: illness · come · like · mountain · collapse, illness · go · like · draw · silk
natural: illness strikes fast but leaves slowly

meaning.en: Illness comes like a collapsing mountain and leaves like silk being drawn out: it strikes quickly but recovers slowly.
meaning.zh: 生病来得很突然，而病好却很缓慢，像抽丝一样一点点。

equivalents: illness arrives on horseback and leaves on foot

examples.zh: 病来如山倒，病去如抽丝，你要好好养着。
examples.en: Illness comes like a landslide and goes like silk being drawn; rest up properly.

examples.zh: 病来如山倒，病去如抽丝，康复要有耐心。
examples.en: Illness strikes fast and fades slowly, so be patient with recovery.

examples.zh: 奶奶病来如山倒，养了半年才恢复。
examples.en: Grandma fell ill suddenly and took half a year to recover.

usage.en: Used to console or advise patience while recovering.
usage.zh: 劝人耐心养病。

pinyin: chéng yóu qín jiǎn bài yóu shē
literal: success · due to · diligence · thrift, failure · due to · extravagance
natural: diligence builds, extravagance ruins

meaning.en: Success comes from diligence and thrift, failure from extravagance.
meaning.zh: 成功都是由于勤劳节俭，失败都是由于奢侈浪费。

examples.zh: 成由勤俭败由奢，创业者要懂得节制。
examples.en: Success comes from diligence and thrift and failure from extravagance; entrepreneurs must restrain themselves.

examples.zh: 家族的兴衰，成由勤俭败由奢。
examples.en: A family's rise and fall: success comes from thrift, failure from extravagance.

examples.zh: 成由勤俭败由奢，这句诗是家训。
examples.en: 'Success comes from thrift, failure from extravagance' is a family motto.

story.en: Li Shangyin's poem 'Ode on History': 'Reviewing the past worthies of states and families, success comes from diligence and thrift, ruin from extravagance' (历览前贤国与家，成由勤俭破由奢), commonly quoted with 败 for 破.
story.zh: 李商隐《咏史》：“历览前贤国与家，成由勤俭破由奢。”常引作“败由奢”。

usage.en: Quoted in advice on thrift; the first half of the couplet often omitted.
usage.zh: 常用于劝勤俭节约。

pinyin: bù qiú yǒu gōng, dàn qiú wú guò
literal: not · seek · merit, only · seek · no · fault
natural: play it safe

meaning.en: Not seeking credit but only to avoid blame: to play safe and avoid risk.
meaning.zh: 不追求立功，只求不犯错误。形容安于现状、缺乏进取心。

equivalents: aim to avoid blame rather than win praise

examples.zh: 他做事不求有功，但求无过，从不创新。
examples.en: He does things merely to avoid blame, never innovating.

examples.zh: 不求有功，但求无过的心态会让企业失去活力。
examples.en: A mentality of seeking no merit but no fault drains a company's vitality.

examples.zh: 干部不能抱着不求有功的态度。
examples.en: Cadres can't take an attitude of seeking only to avoid blame.

usage.en: Usually critical; describes passive attitudes at work.
usage.zh: 多含批评，形容工作中消极的心态。

pinyin: wàn shì jù bèi, zhǐ qiàn dōng fēng
literal: ten-thousand · matters · all · ready, only · lack · east · wind
natural: all set except the one crucial thing

meaning.en: Everything is ready except the east wind: only one crucial condition is missing.
meaning.zh: 一切都准备好了，只差最后一个关键条件。

equivalents: all we need now is a bit of luck
everything's ready but one crucial factor

examples.zh: 新产品万事俱备，只欠东风，就等审批通过。
examples.en: Everything is ready for the new product except the east wind: we're just waiting for approval.

examples.zh: 万事俱备，只欠东风，就差一笔资金了。
examples.en: All is ready but for the east wind; we only lack some funds.

examples.zh: 婚礼的准备万事俱备，只欠东风的是天气。
examples.en: Wedding preparations are complete except for the east wind: the weather.

story.en: In the Romance of the Three Kingdoms (ch. 49), Zhuge Liang tells Zhou Yu that for the fire attack at Red Cliff 'all is ready, only the east wind is lacking' (万事俱备，只欠东风), and then 'borrows' the wind.
story.zh: 《三国演义》第四十九回：诸葛亮为周瑜写下“欲破曹公，宜用火攻；万事俱备，只欠东风”，后设坛借东风。

usage.en: Describes a plan stalled by one missing factor.
usage.zh: 形容准备齐全，只差一个关键条件。

pinyin: xiàng zhuāng wǔ jiàn, yì zài pèi gōng
literal: Xiang · Zhuang · dance · sword, intent · lies · Pei · Duke
natural: the real target is someone else

meaning.en: Xiang Zhuang dances with his sword, but his aim is Duke Pei: an action whose true target is hidden.
meaning.zh: 项庄表面上舞剑，实际上想杀刘邦。比喻说话或行动表面一套，真实意图另有所指。

equivalents: a pretext with a hidden target

examples.zh: 他请客吃饭，项庄舞剑，意在沛公，是想让我帮忙。
examples.en: His dinner invitation was a ploy: his real aim was to get my help.

examples.zh: 项庄舞剑，意在沛公，这次访问另有目的。
examples.en: The real target is someone else; this visit has another purpose.

examples.zh: 他的批评是项庄舞剑，意在沛公。
examples.en: His criticism was aimed at someone else all along.

story.en: At the Feast at Hong Gate, Xiang Zhuang offered to dance with a sword, his real intention being to strike down Liu Bang (the Duke of Pei) at the banquet; Xiang Bo shielded Liu Bang by dancing too.
story.zh: 《史记·项羽本纪》鸿门宴：项庄拔剑起舞，“其意常在沛公也”，项伯亦拔剑起舞，常以身翼蔽沛公。

usage.en: Often used in negotiating and political commentary, usually of an ulterior motive.
usage.zh: 常用于谈判和政治评论，指别有用心。

pinyin: rén jiān zhèng dào shì cāng sāng
literal: human · world · right · path · is · vicissitudes
natural: the true course of history is change

meaning.en: The right course in the human world is the great sea changes: history advances through great upheavals.
meaning.zh: 人类社会发展的正确道路，是经历巨大变迁。

equivalents: history's true path is one of great change
the way of the world is transformation

examples.zh: 人间正道是沧桑，历史总在变化中向前。
examples.en: The true path of history is great upheaval; history advances through change.

examples.zh: 人间正道是沧桑，这个城市三十年来巨变。
examples.en: In the world's true course is great change; this city has changed enormously in thirty years.

examples.zh: 人间正道是沧桑，老一辈经历了无数变迁。
examples.en: The older generation lived through countless upheavals.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律·人民解放军占领南京》（1949年）

story.en: Mao Zedong's poem on the PLA capturing Nanjing ends: 'Heaven is passionate, Heaven too would grow old; the right path in the human world is great change' (天若有情天亦老，人间正道是沧桑).
story.zh: 毛泽东《七律·人民解放军占领南京》（1949年）：“天若有情天亦老，人间正道是沧桑。”

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of history and social change; mostly literary.
usage.zh: 谈论历史和社会变迁时引用，书面色彩浓。

pinyin: yǔ bù jīng rén sǐ bù xiū
literal: words · not · startle · people · die · not · rest
natural: won't rest till my words amaze

meaning.en: I will not rest, even in death, until my words astonish people: an obsession with striking writing.
meaning.zh: 作品的语言如果不能使人惊叹，就至死不罢休。形容刻苦推敲、追求卓越的创作态度。

equivalents: aim to stun with my pen

examples.zh: 他写作语不惊人死不休，一个词也要推敲半天。
examples.en: He writes in a spirit of not stopping until his words astonish, agonising over every word.

examples.zh: 语不惊人死不休，这是诗人的追求。
examples.en: A poet's aim is not to rest until the words stun.

examples.zh: 广告文案要语不惊人死不休，才能吸引眼球。
examples.en: Ad copy must aim to astonish in order to catch attention.

origin.source: 杜甫《江上值水如海势聊短述》

story.en: Du Fu's poem on the river in flood: 'By nature I am addicted to fine lines; if my words do not astonish, I will not rest even in death' (为人性僻耽佳句，语不惊人死不休).
story.zh: 杜甫《江上值水如海势聊短述》：“为人性僻耽佳句，语不惊人死不休。”

usage.en: Usually about writers; also used playfully of attention-seeking talk.
usage.zh: 多指作家创作；也可戏指爱说惊人之语。

pinyin: kāi gōng méi yǒu huí tóu jiàn
literal: draw · bow · there is not · turn · back · arrow
natural: no turning back once the arrow is loosed

meaning.en: Once the bow is drawn, the arrow cannot be called back: once begun, there is no turning back.
meaning.zh: 弓拉开了，射出去的箭不能再回头。比喻事情一旦开始，就不能后退。

examples.zh: 开弓没有回头箭，既然决定了就要做到底。
examples.en: Once the bow is drawn the arrow doesn't turn back; now we've decided, we'll see it through.

examples.zh: 开弓没有回头箭，事到如今只能前进。
examples.en: There's no going back now; all we can do is press on.

examples.zh: 辞职信发出，开弓没有回头箭了。
examples.en: The resignation letter is sent, and there's no turning back.

usage.en: Describes commitment; sometimes tinged with risk.
usage.zh: 表示决心，有时带有风险意味。

pinyin: léi shēng dà, yǔ diǎn xiǎo
literal: thunder · sound · loud, rain · drops · small
natural: much noise, little action

meaning.en: Loud thunder but few raindrops: a lot of fuss but little result.
meaning.zh: 雷声很响，雨点却很小。比喻声势大，实际行动或效果很小。

examples.zh: 这个计划雷声大，雨点小，最后不了了之。
examples.en: The plan was all thunder and no rain, and fizzled out.

examples.zh: 别只是雷声大雨点小，要拿出实际行动。
examples.en: Don't just make noise with no rain; take real action.

examples.zh: 他的威胁雷声大，雨点小，没人当真。
examples.en: His threats were all noise and no action; nobody took them seriously.

usage.en: Criticism of showy efforts that lack results.
usage.zh: 批评虚张声势、成效不大的做法。

pinyin: yī bù zuò, èr bù xiū
literal: one · not · do, two · not · stop
natural: in for a penny, in for a pound

meaning.en: Either don't do it, or if you do, see it through: having started, go all the way.
meaning.zh: 要么不做，做了就做到底。多指已经开始，索性不顾一切干到底。

equivalents: in for a penny, in for a pound
might as well go all the way

examples.zh: 既然已经开了头，一不做，二不休，干脆干到底。
examples.en: Having begun, we may as well go all the way.

examples.zh: 他一不做二不休，把所有积蓄都投进去了。
examples.en: He decided to go through with it and put all his savings in.

examples.zh: 一不做，二不休，今天必须把事情解决。
examples.en: In for a penny, in for a pound: we must settle this today.

usage.en: Can express resolve or reckless determination; casual.
usage.zh: 可表示决心，也可能含有孤注一掷的意味。

pinyin: shuō shí chí, nà shí kuài
literal: say · time · slow, that · time · fast
natural: no sooner said than done

meaning.en: It takes long to tell but it happened in a flash: used when narrating sudden events.
meaning.zh: 说起来慢，当时发生得很快。常用于叙述突然发生的事情。

examples.zh: 说时迟，那时快，他一把拉住了孩子。
examples.en: Quick as a flash, he grabbed the child.

examples.zh: 说时迟那时快，球已经飞进了球门。
examples.en: In the blink of an eye the ball was in the net.

examples.zh: 说时迟，那时快，大门突然被撞开了。
examples.en: Just then, the door suddenly burst open.

usage.en: Narrative transition in storytelling; casual, typical of old novels.
usage.zh: 叙事过渡语，口语，常见于古典小说和评书。

pinyin: tiān bù pà, dì bù pà
literal: heaven · not · fear, earth · not · fear
natural: fears nothing

meaning.en: Afraid of neither heaven nor earth: absolutely fearless.
meaning.zh: 连天和地都不怕。形容无所畏惧。

equivalents: afraid of neither man nor beast

examples.zh: 这孩子天不怕，地不怕，什么都敢尝试。
examples.en: This child is afraid of nothing and willing to try anything.

examples.zh: 他天不怕地不怕，就怕老婆生气。
examples.en: He fears neither heaven nor earth, only his wife's anger.

examples.zh: 她是个天不怕，地不怕的女汉子。
examples.en: She's a fearless tomboy afraid of nothing.

usage.en: Often followed by 就怕… for humour.
usage.zh: 常接“就怕……”，带幽默色彩。

pinyin: dà shì huà xiǎo, xiǎo shì huà liǎo
literal: big · matter · turn · small, small · matter · turn · nothing
natural: make little of problems

meaning.en: Turn big matters into small ones and small ones into nothing: smooth over trouble.
meaning.zh: 把大的事情化成小事，小事化成没有事。多指息事宁人，也指为了逃避责任而掩盖问题。

examples.zh: 邻居吵架，大家劝他们大事化小，小事化了。
examples.en: The neighbours quarrelled and everyone urged them to play it down.

examples.zh: 大事化小，小事化了，是息事宁人的态度。
examples.en: Making little of big matters and nothing of small ones is a conciliatory attitude.

examples.zh: 公司对事故大事化小，引起了公众不满。
examples.en: The firm played the accident down and aroused public anger.

usage.en: Can be positive (conciliatory) or negative (hushing things up), depending on context.
usage.zh: 视语境可褒可贬，既指化解矛盾，也指掩盖问题。

pinyin: bá chū luó bo dài chū ní
literal: pull · out · radish · bring · out · mud
natural: pull one radish and mud comes too

meaning.en: Pull up a radish and the mud comes with it: tackling one matter reveals others tied up with it.
meaning.zh: 拔出一个萝卜，会带出泥土。比喻查处一件事或一个人，牵扯出相关的其他事或人。

equivalents: pull one thread and the whole thing unravels

examples.zh: 这案子拔出萝卜带出泥，牵出了一大批人。
examples.en: In this case pulling up one radish brought up the mud, implicating many people.

examples.zh: 调查下去，拔出萝卜带出泥。
examples.en: As the investigation went on, one lead pulled up many others.

examples.zh: 别乱动这个旧系统，小心拔出萝卜带出泥。
examples.en: Don't touch that old system, or one change will drag up other problems.

usage.en: Often about investigations; casual.
usage.zh: 多用于调查，口语。

pinyin: kě lián tiān xià fù mǔ xīn
literal: pitiable · under · heaven · parents · hearts
natural: all parents' hearts deserve pity

meaning.en: Pity the hearts of parents everywhere: parents' devotion and worry for their children are boundless.
meaning.zh: 天下做父母的心都值得怜惜，形容父母为儿女操心牵挂。

equivalents: a parent's heart is full of worry

examples.zh: 可怜天下父母心，他们为孩子操碎了心。
examples.en: Pity parents everywhere: they've worried themselves sick over their children.

examples.zh: 可怜天下父母心，母亲每天都给孩子打电话。
examples.en: A mother's heart is never at rest; she calls her child every day.

examples.zh: 直到做了父亲，他才懂得可怜天下父母心。
examples.en: Only on becoming a father did he understand how parents' hearts ache.

usage.en: Typically used in sympathetic comments about parents.
usage.zh: 常用于对父母处境的感叹。
